In this paper, we introduce a multi-question generation model (mQG) that generates diverse and contextually relevant questions ... We train mQG with the FairytaleQA dataset, which is constructed for educational purposes ... We also evaluate on TellMeWhy and SQuAD1.1 datasets.

guideline: Annotators ranked models on diversity dimensions (type, syntax, content) and rated questions on appropriateness and answerability.
Annotators rank models on diversity (type, syntax, content) and quality (appropriateness, answerability) using a 1‑3 or 1‑5 scale.

For each question set, the annotators rank the three models on a scale of 1 (highest) to 3 (lowest) based on three dimensions of diversity: type—whether the three selected questions have different question types; syntax—whether the three selected questions use different syntax; and content—whether the three selected questions need to be addressed with diverse answers.
